title: Harbor and Letters
author: U. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Ivo Vasquez, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
